system.name: Echo Descent
system.description: Beyond Floor 70, five heroes cross unstable strata shaped by three daily laws and return with permanent Resonance.
system.mechanic_summary: Three daily laws reshape damage, recovery, and combat openings.

mutations.name: Starved Current
mutations.description: Heroes gain 50% less Mana from their turns.

mutations.name: Sanguine Casting
mutations.description: Each hero active skill costs 8% of that hero's maximum Health after it resolves.

mutations.name: Severed Grace
mutations.description: All healing received by heroes is reduced by 40%.

mutations.name: Null Ward
mutations.description: Enemies are immune to Magic damage. Bring Melee or Ranged attackers.

mutations.name: Adamant Ward
mutations.description: Enemies are immune to Melee and Ranged damage. Bring Magic attackers.

mutations.name: Prismatic Memory
mutations.description: After an enemy takes a damage type, it is immune to that type until struck by a different one.

mutations.name: Triune Fracture
mutations.description: Attack an enemy with Melee, Ranged, and Magic damage to expose it to 30% more damage for the encounter.

mutations.name: Keen Rupture
mutations.description: A damaging critical hit exposes its target to 18% more damage for 2 turns.

mutations.name: Hexbreak
mutations.description: Applying a harmful effect exposes that enemy to 20% more damage for 2 turns.
